_source: FSRS-aligned evaluation. All scheduling/levels/points derive from per-card FSRS state.

levels._notes_points: Weight applied to stability-gain in days. Higher CEFR = more points per day of consolidation.
levels._notes_threshold: subLevel = max L such that ≥N cards at question.level ≤ L have stability ≥ T_L. Decimal interpolation between levels.

fsrs._notes_target: FSRS schedules so retrievability decays to this value before next review.
fsrs._notes_params: ts-fsrs ships with optimized FSRS-5 default weights. Override here only after running the optimizer on real review data.

scoring_rules._retrieve_phase: Two-stage: pick option, then (if correct) self-grade Hard/Good/Easy on a flip card before the explanation. Wrong answers skip the flip card.

grade_mapping._notes: User's self-grade on the flip card → FSRS grade. Wrong always Again.

sampling._notes: Weights for pickNextQuestion. Boss bypasses this and uses deterministic composition.

serve_level_distribution._notes: pickServeLevel(estimate): 70% at round(estimate), 15% one level up, 15% one level down. Clamped to [1, 5].

rank_tiers._notes: Recalibrate after a real session — current cutoffs assume new points = stability_gain × LEVEL_POINTS produces lower magnitudes than the old multiplier formula.

time_thresholds._notes: Used to derive speedTag (fast/normal/slow). Speed feeds the points multiplier in scoring_rules.speed_multiplier — it does not affect the FSRS grade (the user's flip-card self-grade owns that).

bosses.unlock_rule: Boss level L is unlocked when EVERY active sub in that domain has subLevel >= L (subLevel derived from FSRS aggregates).

difficulties_thresholds._notes: 'Difficultés récurrentes' home card appears when ≥3 patterns in any active sub have meanR < 0.6 over ≥5 cards. Per-session callout: 2 weakest patterns (by ΔR) seen this session.
